hintReasonFollowBlock: As a defender, block the declarer from taking this trick
hintReasonFollowWin: As declarer, go for this trick
hintReasonLeadHigh: As declarer, lead a strong card to start collecting the tricks the contract needs
hintReasonLeadLow: As a defender, lead a low card and hold your strength back
hintReasonMisereDuck: Misère — duck with a low card so you take no trick at all
hintReasonMisereForce: Force a trick onto the Misère declarer
promptBidHelp: bid <0-4> ... 0=Pass, 1=Gask (7 tricks), 2=Solo (8 tricks), 3=Misere (0 tricks, no trump), 4=Vira (10 tricks); any non-pass bid must beat the current one
promptPlayHelp: play <idx> ... play a card (A high; must follow the led suit)
promptRoundEndHelp: nr / nextround ... score and go to the next round
promptTrickEndHelp: n / next ... go to the next trick
helpExampleBid: pass                 drop out of the bidding
